summary: Precision Drilling filed a 6-K furnishing a press release announcing renewal of its Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB), the Canadian equivalent of a US buyback authorization, approved by the TSX. Precision may acquire up to 1,229,799 common shares, roughly 10% of the 12,297,993-share public float as of September 8, 2026; 12,587,470 shares were outstanding. Purchases may begin September 21, 2026 and terminate by September 20, 2027, at market prices for cancellation, subject to a 22,165-share daily cap with permitted weekly block purchases. Funding comes from available resources. Watch actual repurchase pace, cancellation-driven float shrinkage, and liquidity in PD/PDS shares.
